informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy (< 3 Months) & Passport-Style Colour Photograph (For Tourist Guide ID Card & Badge)
alternatives: Certified Passport + Valid Work/Residence Permit (foreign nationals)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your certified SA ID copy (< 3 months), proof of residential address, and a clear passport-style colour photo.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified South African ID (or Passport + valid work permit) certified within 90 days, plus passport photo.

informationToProvide.label: CATHSSETA Tourist Guiding Qualification Certificate
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of CATHSSETA-accredited training provider qualification.

informationToProvide.label: Valid First Aid Certificate (Level 1 or higher)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Must be current and accredited by Department of Labour / DoEL.

informationToProvide.label: Police Clearance Certificate / SAPS Name Clearance
Province of Registration, Guiding Category (Nature / Culture / Adventure), Geographical Sites/Regions & Languages Spoken
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the Provincial Tourist Guide Registrar (e.g. Western Cape, Gauteng, KZN, Mpumalanga), your guiding category on your CATHSSETA certificate, and any foreign language endorsements.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect and verify CATHSSETA and First Aid credentials
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificates verified against provincial tourism registrar requirements

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare tourist guide application and code of ethics pack
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application form, photo specs, and payment vouchers completed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver pack and registrar submission instructions
